Confidence intervals for
squared semipartial correlation coefficients
and Cohen's f-squared
are generated using
the `SCorSqNB()` and `FSqNB()` functions from the `betaNB` package.
In this example,
we use the data set and the model used in
[betaNB: Example Using the BetaNB Function](example-beta-nb.html).


``` r
library(betaNB)
```




``` r
df <- betaNB::nas1982
```

### Regression

Fit the regression model using the `lm()` function.


``` r
object <- lm(QUALITY ~ NARTIC + PCTGRT + PCTSUPP, data = df)
```

### Nonparametric Bootstrap


``` r
nb <- NB(object)
```

### Squared Semipartial Correlation Coefficients

The semipartial correlation is signed,
and its interval may contain zero.
`SCorSqNB()` returns the image of the signed interval under squaring.
It is not the interval of squared draws.


``` r
SCorSqNB(nb, level = 0.95, type = "pc")
#>               est       lower     upper
#> NARTIC  0.1858925 0.082085508 0.3178744
#> PCTGRT  0.1176542 0.035160103 0.2253204
#> PCTSUPP 0.0568722 0.008988267 0.1378253
```


``` r
SCorSqNB(nb, level = 0.95, type = "bca")
#>               est      lower     upper
#> NARTIC  0.1858925 0.09757626 0.3527324
#> PCTGRT  0.1176542 0.04734208 0.2549741
#> PCTSUPP 0.0568722 0.01093060 0.1456826
```

### Cohen's f-Squared


``` r
out <- FSqNB(nb, alpha = 0.05)
```

## Methods

### summary


``` r
summary(out, type = "pc")
#> Call:
#> FSqNB(object = nb, alpha = 0.05)
#> 
#> Cohen's f-squared (fsq) and local f-squared
#> type = "pc"
#>            est     se    R   2.5%  97.5%
#> fsq     4.1158 1.6945 5000 2.2572 8.8063
#> NARTIC  0.9510 0.4336 5000 0.3885 2.0534
#> PCTGRT  0.6019 0.3109 5000 0.1868 1.3805
#> PCTSUPP 0.2909 0.2281 5000 0.0469 0.9008
```

### coef


``` r
coef(out)
#>       fsq    NARTIC    PCTGRT   PCTSUPP 
#> 4.1157764 0.9509843 0.6018924 0.2909455
```

### vcov


``` r
vcov(out)
#>               fsq     NARTIC     PCTGRT    PCTSUPP
#> fsq     2.8714074 0.43998299 0.24447264 0.19244613
#> NARTIC  0.4399830 0.18796923 0.02836989 0.02032194
#> PCTGRT  0.2444726 0.02836989 0.09667362 0.01004513
#> PCTSUPP 0.1924461 0.02032194 0.01004513 0.05204723
```

### confint


``` r
confint(out, level = 0.95, type = "pc")
#>              2.5 %    97.5 %
#> fsq     2.25717169 8.8062790
#> NARTIC  0.38852205 2.0534299
#> PCTGRT  0.18684212 1.3805412
#> PCTSUPP 0.04690446 0.9007801
```
